reviews.reason: ApplicationTemplateCatalogPanel.tsx:184 的 DataTable.emptyText 是明确的 ReactNode 空内容 slot，传入本地化 Empty；其输入搜索和游标分页仍由页面自己提供。ApplicationTemplateCatalogPanel.test.tsx 的 search resets pagination and an empty last page cannot advance 断言 No application templates available. 和禁用 Next page，同时断言搜索后导航 q=gateway/cursor=undefined；replaces server pages 场景断言旧行替换并返回访问过的 cursor。这里没有以新 JSX 作 component type，测试覆盖空态/分页内容合同而非 render 性能。 Reassessed 2026-11-03: Catalog read and install are distinct system-template operations. URL q/cursor still seed independently editable search and reset pagination; DataTable.emptyText remains a ReactNode slot.

ApplicationTemplateCatalogPanel.tsx:38–59,185–195 的 searchText 是 Input.Search.onChange 可编辑草稿，只有 onSearch 才 trim 并 navigate 提交 q、重置 cursor；q effect 负责外部 URL 值同步并清分页历史，不能把输入直接派生为 q 的只读值。ApplicationTemplateCatalogPanel.test.tsx 的 search resets pagination and an empty last page cannot advance 从 q=old/cursor=old-cursor 编辑为 gateway，断言导航 q=gateway/cursor=undefined；fetches the URL cursor and query 断言请求使用 URL 值。未宣称已有 q-changing browser-back 测试。 Reassessed 2026-11-03: Catalog read and install are distinct system-template operations. URL q/cursor still seed independently editable search and reset pagination; DataTable.emptyText remains a ReactNode slot.

The source intentionally performs a per-item mutation/install sequence and records its individual receipt before advancing; request parallelization is a separate behavior/resource policy, not a missing await optimization. ExtensionUploadModal owns one upload batch transaction: queued/uploading/installing/challenge/error phases and per-file progress. Its loop processes server installation/risk overrides in selected order and patches the corresponding item before moving on; arbitrary parallelization could interleave confirmations and extension installs. Status is an asynchronous live announcement, not a form output calculation. Reassessed 2026-11-03: extension_center.install.upload gates batch start and confirmation. The ordered per-file upload/install/risk challenge loop and individual receipts remain intentionally sequential.
